reflection_steps.finding: The local app-server path is now reliable enough for Cicero, Kierkegaard, and Aristotle status receipts.

Arby and Aster still need open-gap handling because their CLI final message files are not present.
Launching more CLI work before resolving the pending watcher would reduce clarity, so x2 keeps them pending.
The command book surface already exposes command count, mode count, live count, and connector count.
The next command work should validate fields and expose reader-friendly indexes rather than adding volume.
The skill index observed hundreds of user skills but only publishes frontmatter metadata samples.
Skill repair remains separate from ordinary THOS design unless exact loader errors recur.
The v54/v55 surfaces exist and should be carried as continuity manifests, not archive imports.
Handoff continuity should point to receiver criteria for v5 rather than re-opening old phase bodies.
The v49 Journey file is locally present and can support continuity reflection only.
Older Journey concepts can inspire system language but cannot validate GMUT or promote canon.
Thirty-two current web searches were completed for the v4 x2 source refresh.
Source URLs are recorded as implementation context, with official sources preferred.
Codex CLI 0.136.0 is locally observed, making current CLI diagnostics more meaningful.
The app-server README remains the source anchor for local app-lane routing assumptions.
MCP authorization and tools docs strengthen connector boundary design.
Push protection and workflow hardening remain directly relevant to exact-stage publication discipline.
Windows sandbox and integrity docs support observed-readiness language, not assumptions.
Execution policy is a useful control but not a complete security boundary.
List-form helper commands and temp-directory discipline keep runner scripts safer.
OpenTelemetry signal language should become a receipt schema layer in v5.
Docker and Kubernetes scheduling docs warn against duplicate starts without idempotence.
Vertex AI and Agent Engine docs are architecture references only unless separately deployed.
DGX, NIM, and Nemotron sources are capacity/model context only.
The ordinary THOS publication path still needs JSON parse, compile, guard, exact stage, push, verify.
All six GMUT gates remain open and must be repeated in x2 closeout.
v477 v5 x1 is the correct next phase after v477 v4 x2.
x3/x4 should be used only for concrete blockers, not decorative expansion.
The long v477-v490 objective remains active; this turn publishes one more verified step.
